Pálcás téglalap (03 §3.1 B)

Abbreviations (US terms)
ch – chain
dc – double crochet
st(s) – stitch(es)

Stitch key (US terms)
chain (ch)
double crochet (dc)

Pálcás téglalap
Foundation: ch 19.
Row 1: Starting in 5th ch from hook (skipped ch count as 1 dc), 15 dc (16 sts). Turn.
Rows 2–15: ch 3 (counts as 1 dc), 15 dc (16 sts). Turn.
Row 16: ch 3 (counts as 1 dc), 15 dc (16 sts). Fasten off.
